description.zh: 异步导出任务 ID（由 AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge / AsyncExportInventoryAsset 返回）
description.en: The asynchronous export task ID returned by AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge or AsyncExportInventoryAsset.

title.zh: 获取导出异步任务状态

descriptions.zh: 根据 AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge / AsyncExportInventoryAsset 返回的 exportTaskId 轮询任务状态。status=SUCCESS 时返回 OSS 预签名 downloadUrl（每次查询现签）；status=FAILED 时返回 errorMessage；status=RUNNING 时无 downloadUrl。
descriptions.en: Polls the task status based on the exportTaskId returned by AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge or AsyncExportInventoryAsset. When status is SUCCESS, a pre-signed OSS downloadUrl is returned (signed on each query). When status is FAILED, an errorMessage is returned. When status is RUNNING, no downloadUrl is returned.
